codegen_trace.note: Reactive single-controller system: IR sensor input, endTask shutdown, advisory motor commands to the differential-drive layer via Actuator.move.
Composition: Sensor (IR distance), Actuator (last motor command), clockResetTime state variable, single step() state machine.

Three operating modes; Moving is initial. The terminal mode is realised as the absorbing live mode 'Halted' (see post_codegen design_choice: no Final state in the theory-generated controller per CLAUDE.md).
moveVel=1.0, turnVel=2.0, obstacleThreshold=0.5, turnDuration=2.0.
Sealed interface with signal records Obstacle, Tick, EndTask.
Move(lv, av) output realised as the two-argument Actuator.move(lv, av) call (RoboChart LOperations Call route for multi-payload outputs).
distance() returns latest IR reading; large default 100.0 m when no reading is available.
Stores last issued command; exposes lastLinearVel/lastAngularVel for inspection.
Sole sensor measurement consumed by the controller.
Set from timer.now() on the Moving->Turning transition; consumed by the turnDurationElapsed predicate.
Time source backing clockResetTime and the since()-style elapsed-time predicate.
Moving entry: Move(moveVel, 0) issued on the Turning->Moving transition and at power-up (constructor).
Turning entry: Move(0, turnVel) issued and clockResetTime recorded on the Moving->Turning transition.
Terminal mode entry: Move(0, 0) issued on the endTask transitions into Halted (the Final-equivalent absorbing mode).
Named predicate obstacleDetected = sensor.distance() <= OBSTACLE_THRESHOLD, guard on Moving->Turning.
Named predicate turnDurationElapsed = timer.now() - clockResetTime >= TURN_DURATION, guard on Turning->Moving.
currentMode initialised to SRangerMode.Moving at construction.
Moving block: obstacle event (with obstacleDetected guard) -> Turning, sets clockResetTime, issues Move(0, turnVel).
Moving block: endTask -> Halted, issues Move(0, 0).
Moving block: tick -> Moving self-loop, no action.
Turning block: autonomous turnDurationElapsed -> Moving, issues Move(moveVel, 0).
Turning block: endTask -> Halted, issues Move(0, 0).
Turning block: tick -> Turning self-loop, no action.

Each behavioural requirement maps to exactly one branch; no duplicate (mode, trigger) pairs. The Halted tick self-loop is the only extra branch (liveness cover for the terminal mode), and it introduces no duplicate.
